=== pets/list-pets.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Pets
# operationId: listPets
# Everything about pets.

request:
  name: List pets
  method: GET
  url: ${PETS_BASE_URL}/pets
  headers:
    X-API-Key: ${PETS_API_KEY}
  params:
    # # How many pets to return.
    # limit: "1"
  expect:
    status: 200

=== pets/create-pet.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Pets
# Everything about pets.

request:
  name: Create pet
  method: POST
  url: ${PETS_BASE_URL}/pets
  headers:
    X-API-Key: ${PETS_API_KEY}
    Content-Type: application/json
  body:
    id: 1
    name: Rex
    tag: string
  expect:
    status: 201

=== store/place-order.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Pets

request:
  name: Place order
  method: POST
  url: ${PETS_BASE_URL}/store/orders
  headers:
    X-API-Key: ${PETS_API_KEY}
    Content-Type: application/json
  body:
    petId: 1
    quantity: 1
  expect:
    status: 200

=== pets/get-pet.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Pets
# Everything about pets.

global:
  variables:
    petId: "1"

request:
  name: Get pet
  method: GET
  url: ${PETS_BASE_URL}/pets/${petId}
  headers:
    X-API-Key: ${PETS_API_KEY}
  expect:
    status: 200

=== pets/upload-photo.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Pets
# Everything about pets.

global:
  variables:
    petId: "1"

request:
  name: Upload photo
  method: POST
  url: ${PETS_BASE_URL}/pets/${petId}/photo
  headers:
    X-API-Key: ${PETS_API_KEY}
  formData:
    file: { file: ./pick-a-file }
    # # Shown under the photo.
    # caption: string
  expect:
    status: 200

=== users/get-user.yaml
# Imported from OpenAPI: Pets

global:
  variables:
    username: alice

request:
  name: Get user
  method: GET
  url: ${PETS_BASE_URL}/users/${username}
  headers:
    X-API-Key: ${PETS_API_KEY}
  expect:
    status: 200
